sentences.en: Teachers should occasionally let their students blow off some steam.
sentences.zh: 老师们偶尔应该让学生发泄一下。

sentences.en: A strong wind is blowing and I can't walk fast.
The strong yen was a fatal blow to the company.
sentences.zh: 日元强势对公司来说是致命的打击。
